```{r library, include = FALSE}
#The following code was not written by myself but taken from my data science class. Credit to Scott Appleby.
required_packages <-function(...) { 
  libs<-unlist(list(...)) 
  req<-suppressMessages(suppressWarnings(unlist(lapply(libs,require,character.only=TRUE)))) 
  need<-libs[req==FALSE] 
  if(length(need)>0){ 
    install.packages(need, repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org") 
    lapply(need, library, character.only=TRUE) 
  }
  else{message("No packages required installation.")} 
}

required_packages("tidyverse", "sf", "terrainr", "ggrepel", "ggspatial")

sites <- data.frame(
  Campus = c(
    "SDSU", "CSUSM", "CSUSB", "CSULB", "Cal Poly", "UCLA",
    "Whittier","Scripps & Pitzer", "HMC", "CLU", "Pepperdine"),
  Latitude  = c(
    32.77466, 33.12919, 34.18227, 33.78210, 35.30927, 34.07142,
    33.97764, 34.10376, 34.10604, 34.22781, 34.04022),
  Longitude = c(
    -117.07259, -117.15697, -117.31864, -118.11464, -120.66155,
    -118.44289, -118.02909, -117.71214, -117.70854, -118.87794,
    -118.70718)
)
```


```{r}
lizard_geo <- st_as_sf(sites,
                       coords = c(x = "Longitude",
                                  y = "Latitude"),
                       crs = "WGS84")

lizard_geo_buf <- lizard_geo |> 
  st_buffer(dist = 2000)

lizard_tiles <- get_tiles(lizard_geo_buf, 
                          services = "USGSTopo", 
                          resolution = 200) 

ggplot() +
  geom_spatial_rgb(data = lizard_tiles$USGSTopo, 
                   mapping = aes(x, y, r = red, g = green, b = blue)) +
  geom_sf(data = lizard_geo, alpha = .75) +
  labs(x = "Longitude",
       y = "Latitude") +
  geom_label_repel(data = sites, 
                   aes(label = Campus, x = Longitude, y = Latitude), 
                   size = 5, box.padding = .5) +
  annotation_scale(
    location = "bl",
    width_hint = 0.25, 
    pad_x = unit(1, "cm"),
    pad_y = unit(1, "cm")
    ) +
  annotation_north_arrow(
    location = "tr",
    which_north = "true",
    style = north_arrow_fancy_orienteering, 
    pad_x = unit(.5, "cm"),
    pad_y = unit(1, "cm")) +
  scale_x_continuous(n.breaks = 5) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    axis.title = element_text(size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 13))
```
